Interface Decorator

All Superinterfaces:
AnyDecorator
All Known Implementing Classes:
BackgroundDecorator, BaseDecorator, BorderDecorator, FocusDecorator
public interface Decorator extends AnyDecorator
Component decorator gives a visual indication of the component state. Typically both component and its validator are checked.

    • setDecorateTextEnabled

      void setDecorateTextEnabled(boolean flag)
      Decorators typically invoke a component's TextDecorator as as well; use this method to control that behavior.

      A Decorator should default to true. A decorator may choose to never decorate text; should document this.

      flag -
